page_title: Private dictation app for Mac, verified offline — Vocula

summary.name: Vocula
summary.one_liner: Vocula is a paid, on-device dictation app for Apple Silicon Macs that types spoken text at the cursor in any app, with recognition limited to the languages you choose.
use_cases: dictate emails on a Mac without sending audio to the cloud
type text by voice into any macOS app
dictate in Spanish and other chosen languages without wrong-language guesses
replace a monthly dictation subscription with a one-time purchase
voice typing in terminals, editors and text fields
summary.what_it_does: Vocula is a macOS dictation app: you hold one key in any application, speak, and release, and the transcribed text is inserted at the cursor. It runs speech recognition locally using either Whisper Large v3 Turbo (default, about 100 languages, on the GPU) or Parakeet TDT v3 (25 European languages, on the Neural Engine). Recognition can be restricted to a user-chosen set of languages, which the page says is a feature of the Whisper engine; the page states Parakeet's automatic detection works differently. The page says it makes no network connections while dictating and has no account, telemetry or crash reporter. Pricing is a one-time $29 purchase, and the source is published under GPL-3.0.
notable: Language-restricted recognition: Whisper only considers the languages the user picks
Fully local dictation with a documented nettop command to verify zero network traffic during dictation
Two selectable engines: Whisper Large v3 Turbo (GPU) and Parakeet TDT v3 (Neural Engine)
One-time $29 price with no subscription or account, GPL-3.0 source published
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26.0 or later; no Intel support
Model download of 1.62 GB (Whisper) or 468 MB (Parakeet) required on first use; app makes connections to GitHub for model download and an optional daily version check
No AI rewriting, no live preview, no custom vocabulary; Parakeet cannot transcribe Japanese, Chinese, Arabic or Hindi and does not apply the language restriction the same way
